registration.statement: A catalytic turnover is forced only when one complete ordered state-transition word carries the same held catalyst identity from its entry state through every intermediate and returns it to that exact entry state. The cycle frequency is the exact positive relation between counted complete return words and counted parts of one held observation interval. No turnover-frequency equation, continuum rate, Michaelis-Menten or steady-state premise, stochastic cycle weight or fitted catalyst efficiency is imported.
registration.title: Exact catalytic turnover and cycle-frequency law
